title.zh: Qwenputer：Qwen3.5内部一个可运行、确定性的RISC-V CPU
title.en: Qwenputer: A functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5

current_state.zh: Qwenputer已在Qwen3.5-4B权重内实现可运行的32位RISC-V虚拟CPU和可精确读写内存，能执行编译后的C程序并通过RISC-V指令测试，大数乘法测试得分39/40；但模型体积增至18.8GB且计算速度远不如外部工具。
current_state.en: Qwenputer has implemented a working 32-bit RISC-V virtual CPU and exact read/write memory inside Qwen3.5-4B weights, can execute compiled C programs and pass RISC-V instruction tests, and scores 39/40 on large-number multiplication; however, the model grows to 18.8GB and is much slower than external tools.

updates.what_changed_zh: 一名开发者利用门控增量网络层作为精确的类RAM存储，在Qwen3.5内部实现了一个可运行、确定性的RISC-V CPU和文件系统。
updates.what_changed_en: A developer implemented a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU and filesystem inside Qwen3.5 by exploiting gated delta network layers as exact RAM-like storage.

updates.title_zh: 开发者把32位CPU编进千问权重：大模型内部直接运行计算机程序
updates.title_en: 开发者把32位CPU编进千问权重：大模型内部直接运行计算机程序
updates.what_changed_zh: 报道补充了Qwenputer的实现细节和测试结果：开发者为Divyansh Agrawal，在Qwen3.5-4B原有32层前增加11层，将32位RISC-V虚拟CPU编码进权重，并利用Gated DeltaNet实现可精确读写内存；该CPU可运行编译后的C程序，累计执行约1800万条指令未发现错误，在DeepMind 40道大数乘法题中Qwenputer答对39道，而原版Qwen答对22道。方案效率较低，模型文件因大量零值参数增至18.8GB，约为原版两倍。
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds implementation details and test results for Qwenputer: developer Divyansh Agrawal prepended 11 layers to Qwen3.5-4B's original 32 layers to encode a 32-bit RISC-V virtual CPU into the weights, using Gated DeltaNet for exact read/write memory; the CPU runs compiled C programs, executed about 18 million instructions without detected errors, and scored 39/40 on DeepMind's large-number multiplication test versus 22/40 for base Qwen. The approach is inefficient, with the model file growing to 18.8GB, about twice the original, due to many zero-valued parameters.
updates.current_state_zh: Qwenputer已在Qwen3.5-4B权重内实现可运行的32位RISC-V虚拟CPU和可精确读写内存，能执行编译后的C程序并通过RISC-V指令测试，大数乘法测试得分39/40；但模型体积增至18.8GB且计算速度远不如外部工具。
updates.current_state_en: Qwenputer has implemented a working 32-bit RISC-V virtual CPU and exact read/write memory inside Qwen3.5-4B weights, can execute compiled C programs and pass RISC-V instruction tests, and scores 39/40 on large-number multiplication; however, the model grows to 18.8GB and is much slower than external tools.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Independent developer Divyansh Agrawal built Qwenputer by prepending 11 layers to Qwen3.5-4B that encode a 32-bit RISC-V virtual CPU directly into model weights, letting the LLM execute compiled C programs and exact arithmetic internally and scoring 39/40 on DeepMind's large-number multiplication test versus 22/40 for base Qwen.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Independent developer Divyansh Agrawal built Qwenputer by prepending 11 layers to Qwen3.5-4B that encode a 32-bit RISC-V virtual CPU directly into model weights, letting the LLM execute compiled C programs and exact arithmetic internally and scoring 39/40 on DeepMind's large-number multiplication test versus 22/40 for base Qwen.
